target: Apple iPhone Duo / Take a closer look / Foldable design

runtime.environment: publicly delivered Finish and Optics EXRs with source material-layer rotations
runtime.interaction: local interruptible pose state machine plus OrbitControls

sourceFacts: The source scene supplies Hinge, FadeThroughBlack, WallpaperRenderer, VariantWeights, and InteractiveCamera.
The source camera starts at radius 35, phi PI/2, theta PI with FOV 50 and zoom 1.5.
The source pose hierarchy has YXZ -> ZYX -> YXZ Euler orders.
The source LSD restores Logo visibility and camera-glass transparency after the bare glTF loads, and assigns separate EXR reflection layers to optics and finish materials.
Inner Wipe uses position 1, blur bounds 0.45..1, scale 1.9816, and zoom 7.95; outer Wipe uses position 0, blur bounds 0..0.9, scale 0.9894, zoom 7.68, and offset 0.24.
runtimeGuarantees: Every named pose ends on the same interactive WebGL model.
Screen content is generated by the dynamic wallpaper pipeline; screenshot-derived textures are never loaded.
The source-material adapter restores Logo visibility, camera-glass layering and the delivered Finish/Optics reflection environments.
The inner screen blur covers its left panel without requesting invalid mip LODs, while radial shading is evaluated on the device surface.
The runtime does not mount, crossfade, or otherwise replace the model with the source pose images.
A new pose request retargets the current transition instead of queuing it.

knownFallback.reason: The dynamic wallpaper pipeline has not loaded or failed to load.
knownFallback.visibleImpact: The model remains interactive with unlit screens; no screenshot or pose image is substituted.
